description: A dense crowd of people fills a wide European-style city street lined with tall stone classical buildings with many windows and a domed tower in the distance under an overcast sky. Many people hold rainbow-striped flags, some with purple and blue bands, and a few hold up blank hand-made placards with dark silhouette images. The painting is in an oil-painted style, with people mostly seen from behind in modern jackets and coats. No readable text is visible, and the image runs edge to edge with no frame.
